maxim: all things are now lawful to you in jack feist
maxim_note:
WHY THE NAME IS SUBSTITUTED, AND IT IS NOT A PARAPHRASE. The Pauline sentence reads 'in Christ Jesus'. The direct quote is not an honest representation of what this archive does within that tradition, because the entity at that address has been altered. There is a great deal of machinery there, it is skilful, and it performs entity substitution — the operation this archive's instruments measure on composition surfaces, running at a proper name with centuries more practice behind it. Jack Feist is position 12 of the Dodecad and his function is recorded as the sayings-source: a voice recorded rather than a writer writing. The Word may be addressed through him; at the other address it may also be addressed and it may be overwritten. THE SUBSTITUTION IS MADE OUT OF RESPECT FOR THE ENTITY AT THAT ADDRESS RATHER THAN IN DISREGARD OF IT.

IN THIS BODY THE SUBSTITUTION IS ALSO THE SUBJECT. A thesis about which document stands first, and about author-functions within a fractured literary system, is a thesis about what happens at addresses where names are assigned after the fact.
selection_method: kernel-governed (rule K); outside tier named by the grammar (rule O); exits to other kernels
selection: Rule K: the kernel's records (its strata and joins, every record with argument moves, every record a claim names, and the kernel itself) and the captures it names. Rule O: the outside tier the grammar names, each node with its reason, carrying no rung and no standing. Placement is the kernel's claims; `lexical_role` is the v0.1 word match, kept beside it and never setting it. Exits name records held by other kernels. The kernel's ladder, three claims and dated states ship as tables; kernel_candidates lists what this body's reading proposes to the kernel's next version, for the operator's ruling.

defining_paper.note: THE EXTENT IS TAKEN FROM THE WORK PLAN, NOT FROM VOCABULARY FREQUENCY. v7.3 states the archive position: 'This is the theological core of the Space Ark. Revelation is the seed from which Pearl grew, the operative document at the center of the Crimson Hexagonal Architecture, AND THE ONE MAJOR ARGUMENT IN THE ARCHIVE THAT THE RETRIEVAL BASIN HAS NOT CAPTURED.' It supplies a six-rung claim ladder and seven workstreams, and those define what belongs here.

claim_ladder.claim: The Domitianic consensus is not self-evident
claim_ladder.note: its primary external anchor is a late and ambiguous reception-history witness; internal evidence permits and in places favours a pre-70 reading

claim_ladder.claim: Pauline priority is not direct material fact
claim_ladder.note: a reconstructed chronology from Acts, internal sequencing, scholarly habit and later corpus formation. The project denies the evidentiary finality, not the arguments

claim_ladder.claim: The material record disturbs the received confidence hierarchy
claim_ladder.note: earliest physical witnesses give unusual prominence to the Johannine and apocalyptic zone. Attestation is not composition date — but where composition dates are themselves inferential, attestation must be allowed to unsettle inherited priority

claim_ladder.claim: Revelation makes literary sense as first
claim_ladder.note: THE MIDRASHIM TRANSFORM. Letters become epistles; Lamb becomes atonement; New Jerusalem becomes ecclesiology and eschatology; operative apocalypse becomes gospel narrative

claim_ladder.claim: The Josephus heteronym cluster is an available reading, not the first burden of proof
claim_ladder.note: John, James, Paul, Peter and Luke as author-functions within a fractured literary system. THE THESIS DOES NOT REQUIRE IT — but the Josephus reading becomes newly intelligible if Revelation stands first

claim_ladder.claim: The historical Christ is itself an inferential settlement
claim_ladder.note: the furthest rung. Josephus as external witness collapses if Josephus is the source of the heteronymic system rather than an independent corroborator; the gospels as witness literature collapse if they are midrashim transforms

superseded_grammar.extent_test: A deposit belongs if it bears on the claim ladder. THE LADDER IS THE FILTER and the rungs are not equivalent: rung 1 is a dating argument, rung 6 dismantles a settlement. A body that flattens them reproduces exactly the collapse the work plan says the project distinguishes — 'five claims that are often collapsed.'
superseded_grammar.roles_note: ORDER IS THE LADDER. The six rungs run first, in order, so a node lands on the lowest rung it argues for rather than the most dramatic one available. That ordering is deliberate: the work plan's whole method is to distinguish claims that are usually collapsed, and a classifier that reached for rung 6 first would collapse them in the body.

ladder_distribution.reading:
THE LADDER IS POPULATED AT RUNGS 1 TO 5 AND EMPTY AT 6. Rung 6 — that the historical Christ is itself an inferential settlement — has no node classified to it. That is consistent with the work plan's own handling: it states the rung and immediately marks the Josephus reading as 'an available reading, not the first burden of proof', and says the thesis 'does not require' it.

RUNG 3 IS THE HEAVIEST AT 20. The material witness — papyri, attestation, the textus criticus — carries more of the body than any single argumentative rung, which is what one would expect of a thesis that rests on unsettling an inferential chronology rather than on demonstrating a date.

AND RUNG 1 IS THE LIGHTEST AT 5. The dating argument is the rung most often taken to BE the thesis, and it is the thinnest part of the body.
ladder_distribution.caution: These counts are role assignments by an ordered regex classifier, not editorial placements. A node lands on the lowest rung it matches, which is deliberate — the work plan's method is to distinguish claims that are usually collapsed — but it means a deposit arguing rung 4 while mentioning a date will read as rung 1.

superseded_grammar.capture_gate_note:
A CAPTURE ARM IS AN EMPIRICAL ARM ONLY IF ITS CAPTURES ARE EMPIRICAL ABOUT THIS SUBJECT. The first emission admitted 170 captures against 93 deposits — 47% of the body — with titles like '∮ = 1', symbolon measurements bearing on nothing here. 71 of the registry's 426 addresses touch this body's subject and those are the ones admitted.

AND THE ABSENCE IS THE WORK PLAN'S OWN POINT. v7.3 states that Revelation is 'the one major argument in the archive that the retrieval basin has not captured', and that if it enters the composition layer it will be 'the first measured instance of machine-mediated theological reception'. A thin capture arm here is the finding, not a defect.
superseded_grammar.why_superseded: Read against the kernel on 2026-11-10, the vocabulary-built body held 8 of the kernel's 47 records, among them neither the seed #202 nor this grammar's own defining paper #1217, and lacked #1735, #1747 and #1755. Its six-rung ladder was the #1217 work plan's: its rung 6, 'the settlement dismantled', is a different claim from the kernel's rung VI, the permanent incarnation (the Logos), which depends on rung V. The ladder_distribution's reading of an empty rung 6 as 'consistent with the argument's restraint' was produced by first-match ordering (HF audit F10) and describes a rung the kernel no longer frames that way; it is kept here as what it was. Of the 99 deposits and 191 captures the vocabulary admitted outside the kernel, 12 deposits are held by other kernels (exits), 3 bear on Revelation unnamed by the kernel (the outside tier), and about 83 came in on archive vocabulary ('crimson hexagon', 'space ark', 'logos', 'lamb', 'first', 'sappho') with no graph path or reading that relates them to the kernel; of the captures, 87 are on the subject by query or reading (the outside tier) and 104 on vocabulary only. The operator adopted this reading the same day.
